body:
We also struggled with this. An additional problem is that the `<ClearRefinements />` component detects the non-empty `min` value and allows the user to clear it.

As a workaround, we copied the entire `connectRange` function and commented out [this line](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/blob/166db0903cd98b186ce361b10834fc2090dc9cab/packages/instantsearch.js/src/connectors/range/connectRange.ts#L233C45-L233C69):

```diff
- if ((hasMinChange || hasMaxChange) && isMinValid && isMaxValid) {
+ if ((hasMinChange || hasMaxChange) /* && isMinValid && isMaxValid */) {
```

This change disables the auto-ranging functionality, allowing us to pass any values to `refine()`, which are then applied as-is. As a result, we no longer need to set `min` / `max`.

However, an official fix would be very helpful.
